sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: REVERSAL: The COMPLETE dependency contract explicitly declares nltl:span as an operandTerm, so the earlier instruction to remove span is superseded by this contract evidence. Add a required iceStringer-owned nltl:span quantity with the canonical metre unit and bind its qudt:numericValue as the declared span operand, while preserving nltl:stringerSpan for the verified l operand only if both declared operands are semantically distinct.
